# qpx — Full Reference

> Python toolkit for the QPX quantitative proteomics Parquet format.

## Overview

qpx defines a standardized Parquet-based format (QPX) for quantitative proteomics data and provides the `qpxc` command-line tool and a Python API to convert, query, transform, validate and migrate datasets.

A QPX dataset is a folder of files named `{prefix}.{view}.{format}`, for example `PXD014414.feature.parquet`. The data views are psm, feature, pg (protein groups), mz (spectra), xic, pepmap, site, proteoform, protein and fragment; the metadata views are dataset, sample, run, ontology and provenance. Expression matrices are AnnData files (`.ae.h5ad`, `.de.h5ad`), and a conversion can write a MuData view (`.h5mu`).

## Installation

pip install qpx                    # Core (includes mudata, anndata, scipy)
pip install qpx[all]               # All optional extras except pdc
pip install qpx[mzidentml]         # mzIdentML (lxml)
pip install qpx[plotting]          # Visualization (plotly, scikit-learn)
pip install qpx[quantify]          # Protein quantification (mokume[directlfq])
pip install qpx[pdc]               # PDC/CPTAC download (pridepy)

## CLI Usage

### Convert tool output
Each converter writes a dataset into --output-folder; --output-prefix sets the file prefix. convert mz writes the one file named by --output.

qpxc convert maxquant --evidence-file evidence.txt --protein-groups-file proteinGroups.txt --sdrf-file metadata.sdrf.tsv --output-folder qpx_output
qpxc convert diann --report-path report.parquet --pg-matrix-path report.pg_matrix.tsv --sdrf-file metadata.sdrf.tsv --output-folder qpx_output
qpxc convert fragpipe --psm-file psm.tsv --ion-file combined_ion.tsv --pg-file combined_protein.tsv --experiment-annotation-file experiment_annotation.tsv --output-folder qpx_output
qpxc convert spectronaut --report-path report.tsv --sdrf-file metadata.sdrf.tsv --output-folder qpx_output
qpxc convert proteome-discoverer --psm-file PSMs.txt --proteins-file Proteins.txt --input-files InputFiles.txt --output-folder qpx_output
qpxc convert openms-consensus --consensusxml results.consensusXML --sdrf-file metadata.sdrf.tsv --output-folder qpx_output
qpxc convert mzidentml --mzid-path results.mzid --output-folder qpx_output
qpxc convert quantms-msstats --msstats-file msstats_in.csv --sdrf-file metadata.sdrf.tsv --output-folder qpx_output
qpxc convert cdap --psm-dir cdap_psm/ --output-folder qpx_output
qpxc convert mz --mzml-dir mzml/ --output qpx_output/PXD014414.mz.parquet
qpxc convert sdrf --sdrf-file metadata.sdrf.tsv --output-folder qpx_output

### Download and convert PDC/CPTAC studies
qpxc pdc2qpx -a PDC000109 --download-dir downloads --output-folder qpx_output

### Inspect, validate and query
qpxc info --dataset qpx_output
qpxc validate --dataset qpx_output
qpxc query sql --dataset qpx_output --sql "SELECT run_file_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM feature GROUP BY 1" --output counts.csv
qpxc query filter --dataset qpx_output --view feature --condition "charge = 2" --limit 10
qpxc query head --dataset qpx_output --view pg

### Transform
qpxc transform quantify --feature-path qpx_output --method directlfq -o proteins.parquet
qpxc transform gene-map --dataset qpx_output --fasta proteome.fasta --in-place
qpxc transform protein-properties --dataset qpx_output --fasta proteome.fasta --in-place
qpxc transform site --dataset qpx_output --modification Phospho --in-place

### Migrate a dataset written under an older specification
qpxc migrate --dataset old_dataset --output-folder migrated_dataset

## Python API

import qpx

# Open a dataset folder; every view found is available as an attribute
ds = qpx.open_dataset("qpx_output/")
print(ds.available_structures)      # ['psm', 'feature', 'pg', 'dataset', ...]
print(ds.feature.count())

# Filter with a SQL condition and read into pandas
df = ds.feature.filter("charge = 2").to_df()
pg = ds.pg.to_df()

# SQL across one or more datasets
coll = qpx.DatasetCollection([ds])
result = coll.sql("SELECT run_file_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM feature GROUP BY 1")
print(result.to_df())

## QPX Format Specification

Column names are lower snake case. Required columns of the main views:

- psm: psm_id, sequence, peptidoform (ProForma), charge, is_decoy, calculated_mz, observed_mz, run_file_name, scan
- feature: feature_id, sequence, peptidoform, charge, is_decoy, calculated_mz, observed_mz, run_file_name, scan, anchor_protein; intensities holds a list of label and intensity pairs
- pg: pg_id, pg_accessions, anchor_protein, grouped_runs, is_decoy, peptides
- sample: sample_accession, organism, organism_part
- run: run_accession, run_file_name, samples

Scores beyond the typed columns are kept in additional_scores, and the ontology view gives the PSI-MS term of each column and score that has one. The full specification is at https://qpx.quantms.org/spec/.

## Related Tools

- quantms: DDA pipeline that outputs QPX-compatible data (https://docs.quantms.org)
- quantmsdiann: DIA pipeline (https://quantmsdiann.quantms.org)
- mokume: protein quantification from QPX data (https://mokume.quantms.org)
- quantms Portal: hosts QPX datasets (https://portal.quantms.org)
